_comment: THE semver ordering fixture (release identity design gate 8). Every reader of release identities is held to it: src/core/update/release_identity.ts compareReleaseIdentities, scripts/lib/change_log.ts compareVersions, and the shell twin deploy/dedalo-image-lib.sh once it orders identities. 'ascending' is strictly increasing and includes the developer identities (X.Y.Z-dev, owner decision 2026-10-25: 7.0.0 < 7.0.1-alpha.1 < 7.0.1-beta.1 < 7.0.1-rc.1 < 7.0.1-dev < 7.0.1 < 7.0.2; a dev identity sorts above every prerelease of its triple and below its stable). 'dev' lists the developer identities among 'ascending' (the changelog refuses them: a release is never a dev build). 'dev_below_stable' pairs each dev identity with the stable of its own triple (strictly less, both ways). 'not_identities' must be refused by every reader. HAND-EDITED CONTRACT (no generator): the retired equal_dev tie pairs are replaced by dev_below_stable; the dotted spelling 7.0.0.dev is retired, and 7.0.0-dev is now a valid identity.
